description: Get NRFA daily flow or catchment rainfall observations for historical catchment analysis. Use a numeric NRFA station_id, data_type gdf (gauged flow), ndf (naturalised flow) or cdr (catchment rainfall), and ordered YYYY-MM-DD dates at most 366 days apart. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

data_type.description: NRFA series: gdf gauged daily flow, ndf naturalised daily flow, cdr catchment daily rainfall.

end.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no earlier than start, at most 366 days apart.

start.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD; must be no later than end, at most 366 days apart.

station_id.description: Positive numeric NRFA gauging-station identifier; not an EA station ID.

name: nrfa_get_timeseries
